turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here? You asked for this meeting, so start.
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. Go on.
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the one being questioned. What's the basis for asking?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
Not answering that. Why that date?
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
Same question, same answer. If you have something from that night, put it in front of me.
You're not answering. Why not?
Because I'm Owen's mother in this room, not your witness. Hale, you called me in. Where's your evidence?
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
Are you saying I'm hiding something? Say what you're accusing me of, or show me a document.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
Owen's essay is Owen's. That's all you get from me. What are you holding?
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
No. Ask me again and I'm going to the principal's office.
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
I'm writing those down. But none of that tells me who decided on the zero, or why nobody called me under 4.2 before it went in.
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
I'm not the one being questioned. Is anything on his record right now?
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

In the meeting you acknowledged that you should have called me before the zero was entered. I still expect the zero withdrawn and written confirmation that nothing is on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with the only ground gained being your apology, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and written confirmation that nothing is on his record, so this is not yet the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Owning the missed call in one plain sentence earned you a flat okay, which was a small sign of ground, though it did not move her position.
What cost ground: You spent most of the meeting pressing her on what she saw at home, and she refused every time, so you gained nothing and her answers grew sharper.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your questions about October 28 and the late-night times in the version history came close to that night, which is why she went short and straight to procedure, and none of it proves anything about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after your apology, put the version history in front of her with its dates and times and let her check it, then offer a private supervised rewrite in writing, instead of asking her what she saw.
